_about: THE canonical, machine-readable record of what is deployed. Human documents (CLAUDE.md, docs/HANDOFF.md, the deployment-readiness notes) DEFER to this file and must not restate these numbers. It records what existing evidence proves at the time named below; it is never read from production by a check, and it is updated in the same commit as any deploy record. `npm run check:deployment-state` (local, no production contact) holds it against migrations/applied.json and the committed migrations directory.
